summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for ADM Endeavors, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: This report covers the 2021 and 2020 fiscal years, which precede the 2022–2024 period requested in the task. The Consolidated Balance Sheets report Goodwill of $688,778 for 2021 without a separate 'Intangible Assets' line item, and Item 1 states the company claims no ownership of patents or trademarks. While this provides a 2021 baseline for Goodwill, it does not contain the specific 2022, 2023, or 2024 financial statements needed to assess the trend.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The document provides financial statements for 2022 and 2021, reporting Goodwill of $688,778 under noncurrent assets without a separate line item labeled "Intangible Assets," and states in the Business section that the Company claims no ownership of patents or trademarks. It contributes the 2022 data point to the requested trend but does not include financial statements for 2023 or 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document provides financial statements for 2023 and comparative data for 2022, supplying the 2023 data point for the requested 2022–2024 trend. The Consolidated Balance Sheets report "Goodwill" at $688,778 for both periods but do not include a specific line item labeled "Intangible Assets." While this report adds the 2023 position to the collection, it lacks financial data for the 2024 fiscal year and the specific "Intangible Assets" classification required to fully determine the requested trend.
